verdict.rationale: The axis applies: a Secretary of State filing office could plausibly publish forms and instructions for download without an account. The evidence pack holds only robots.txt probes showing bot-challenge walls on nvsos.gov and the ORION portal. Nothing documents whether forms or instructions can be downloaded, with or without an account, so there is no evidence the product delivers this story.

support.subject: As a founder, the forms themselves and their instructions are downloadable from the service's site without an account
